limits: Repeated timings are not independent problems.
New-only depth-three adaptive/fixed-stop policies have no old timing reference.
The selected case subset is a regression cohort, not an estimate over 100 newly solved problems.

275 calls are repeated measurements of 14 distinct problems, not 275 independent problems or 100 fresh cases per strategy.

Performance gates are measured bounds for this selected cohort, not a guarantee for all future problems.
Matched numerical failures prove identical error identities and retained actual prefixes only; those problems remain unresolved and have no full successful plan comparison.
